name: Atonement The
overview: The atonement, as revealed in Scripture, is the divine provision through which Christ bore our griefs and sorrows, taking upon Himself the punishment for our transgressions and iniquities, thus securing our healing and peace. This act, foretold in the Scriptures, demonstrates the reconciliation of God's justice and mercy, as the Lord laid the iniquity of all upon Christ, who willingly came to do the will of God. The atonement is not based on sacrifices or offerings but on Christ's unique and once-for-all work, which opens access to God and is commemorated in the Lord's Supper.
